summary: @servicetitan/anvil-icon preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 727KB payload
details: The package advertises Material Design SVG icons but its preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases (pinned to bun-v1.3.13), extracts the binary, chmods it executable, and uses it to execute a shipped file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB Bun-CJS bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs`) with a string-array rotation decoder (`WV8StW`, `hc1jfK9`) and hex-prefixed identifiers — its content is opaque and unrelated to SVG icon delivery. Both `setup.mjs` and `math_init.js` are shipped in the tarball but are not listed in the `files` allowlist in package.json (which declares only `mdi/{filled,outlined,round,sharp,two-tone}/*.svg`), so the executed attack surface sits outside the author-declared publish set. The alternate-runtime execution path bypasses Node-based inspection and runs automatically on `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
